item: Second sealed held-out readability/correctness suite; source and oracle models are private and never tracked

separation.policy: Development workers MUST NOT read .local/quality-heldout2/ (source, models, gold, inputs, outputs) nor run any decompiler on its inputs outside a measurement round. If breached, mark contaminated and retire; do not silently rename/reselect programs.
